bar.name: Battle Hymn
bar.text: On your first turn of each battle, Holy Strike deals +30% damage.

bar.name: Holy Soil
bar.text: Your skills deal +8% damage to enemies standing in holy fire.

bar.name: Charging Faith
bar.text: Each kill gives you Haste for 1 turn.

bar.name: Kindled Path
bar.text: When an enemy dies in holy fire, Judgment's cooldown drops by 1.

bar.name: Crusader's Oath
bar.text: Once per battle, when you drop below 30% HP, your next skill is a guaranteed critical.

0.f1.name: Wrathful Glow
0.f1.text: Divine Light also smites the weakest enemy for 4% INT holy damage per rank.

0.f2.name: Kindled Resolve
0.f2.text: Allies healed by Divine Light deal +2% damage per rank on their next skill.

0.f3.name: Bedside Watch
0.f3.text: Divine Light heals 4% more per rank on allies below 50% HP.

0.n0.name: No Rest for Evil
0.n0.text: When no ally is wounded, Divine Light smites the weakest enemy for 30% INT holy damage.

0.r.name: Sun-Forged Will
0.r.text: Divine Light's smite +5% per rank against enemies below 50% HP.

0.ea.name: Twofold Light
0.ea.text: Divine Light always smites too: 20% INT holy damage to the weakest enemy.

0.eb.name: Anointed Arms
0.eb.text: The ally healed by Divine Light deals +15% damage on their next skill.

0.ma.name: Chain of Light
0.ma.text: If Divine Light's smite kills, it smites again at once.

0.fa.name: Vengeful Light
0.fa.text: Divine Light's smite deals double, but its heal is 40% weaker.

0.fb.name: Fervent Oath
0.fb.text: Divine Light's damage bonus to allies doubles, but it can no longer heal you.

0.mb.name: Banner of Dawn
0.mb.text: If Divine Light's target was below 50% HP, they also gain Haste for 1 turn.

0.v.name: Crusader's Dawn
0.v.text: Divine Light heals the most wounded ally and smites the weakest enemy for the same amount; a kill refunds 5 MP.

1.f1.name: Relentless Hammer
1.f1.text: Holy Strike +2% power per rank on the enemy you hit last turn.

1.f2.name: Piercing Light
1.f2.text: Holy Strike ignores 3% of Magic Armor per rank.

1.f3.name: Sparking Hammer
1.f3.text: Holy Strike has a 6% chance per rank to set the target Burning for 2 turns.

1.n0.name: First Smite
1.n0.text: Your first Holy Strike each battle is a guaranteed critical hit.

1.r.name: Unyielding Swing
1.r.text: Holy Strike +5% power per rank against front-row enemies.

1.ea.name: Rising Fervor
1.ea.text: Each Holy Strike in a row deals +10% more than the last; using another skill resets it.

1.eb.name: Shockwave
1.eb.text: Holy Strike splashes 30% to the enemies beside the target.

1.ma.name: Hammer Rhythm
1.ma.text: Your third Holy Strike in a row strikes twice.

1.fa.name: Blind Zeal
1.fa.text: Rising Fervor grows +20% per strike, but Divine Light is 30% weaker while it is built up.

1.fb.name: Heavy Hammer
1.fb.text: Holy Strike +35% damage, but it now costs 6 MP.

1.mb.name: Hammerfall Quake
1.mb.text: If Holy Strike kills, the shock hits that enemy's row for 40%.

1.v.name: Hammer of the Heavens
1.v.text: Holy Strike calls down two hammers: the second falls on the enemy with the lowest HP for 60%.

2.f1.name: Life for Life
2.f1.text: Resurrection revives with +4% HP per rank, taken from your own HP.

2.f2.name: Shielded Return
2.f2.text: Revived allies rise with a shield worth 4% of their max HP per rank.

2.f3.name: Desperate Rite
2.f3.text: Resurrection costs 2 less MP per rank while you are below 50% HP.

2.n0.name: Soul Exchange
2.n0.text: Resurrection can be paid with 25% of your current HP instead of MP.

2.r.name: Iron Return
2.r.text: The first hit a revived ally takes is 10% weaker per rank.

2.ea.name: Untouchable Rise
2.ea.text: Revived allies rise Fortified for 1 turn.

2.ma.name: Risen in Glory
2.ma.text: A revived ally gains Blessed for 2 turns and their first skill deals +30%.

2.fa.name: Heavy Absolution
2.fa.text: Revived allies rise with a shield of 30% max HP, but Resurrection cooldown 5 → 7.

2.fb.name: Hasty Rite
2.fb.text: Resurrection's cooldown drops by 2 more, but it revives at only 15% HP.

2.mb.name: Not Yet
2.mb.text: Resurrection costs no MP if the ally fell since your last turn.

2.v.name: Martyr Rising
2.v.text: Resurrection guards your own life: once per battle, if you fall while it is ready, you rise at 40% HP.

3.f1.name: Deep Coals
3.f1.text: Holy fire deals 3% more per rank on its second turn and later.

3.f2.name: Kindling
3.f2.text: Enemies in holy fire take +2% damage per rank from Holy Strike.

3.f3.name: Spark of Wrath
3.f3.text: Judgment has a 6% chance per rank to set each enemy hit Burning for 2 turns.

3.n0.name: Sanctified Earth
3.n0.text: Judgment's holy fire lasts 3 turns instead of 2.

3.r.name: Ash Upon Ash
3.r.text: Holy fire +5% damage per rank against Burning enemies.

3.ea.name: Undying Flame
3.ea.text: Holy fire on a cell where an enemy died keeps burning for the rest of the battle at half power.

3.eb.name: Broad Sentence
3.eb.text: Judgment's plus reaches 1 cell further in each direction.

3.ma.name: Fire on Fire
3.ma.text: Judgment cast on cells that already burn makes the fire there twice as hot.

3.fa.name: Scorched Earth
3.fa.text: Holy fire lasts 2 more turns, but Judgment's cooldown 3 → 5.

3.fb.name: Scattered Flame
3.fb.text: Judgment also covers the center's whole row, but its holy fire deals 30% less.

3.mb.name: Wildfire Verdict
3.mb.text: When an enemy dies in holy fire, the fire jumps to the nearest enemy for 2 turns.

3.v.name: Day of Judgment
3.v.text: When holy fire ends, it erupts: 60% INT holy damage to each enemy still standing in it.

4.u2.name: Scorching Light
4.u2.text: Radiance sets every enemy Burning for 2 turns.

4.u3.name: Wrath of Heaven
4.u3.text: Radiance's damage gets the missing-HP bonus too: up to +50% on the most wounded enemies.

4.r1.name: Final Light
4.r1.text: Radiance deals +40% to enemies below 30% HP.

4.r2.name: Reaping Dawn
4.r2.text: Each enemy Radiance kills restores 5 MP.

4.r3.name: Sunstrike
4.r3.text: If Radiance kills an enemy, its cooldown drops by 2.

4.d1.name: Focused Beam
4.d1.text: Radiance can target one enemy: it skips the heal and deals 220% damage to that enemy only.

4.d2.name: Pillar of Wrath
4.d2.text: The focused beam leaves holy fire on the target's cell for 2 turns.

4.d3.name: Lance of Dawn
4.d3.text: The focused beam pierces the whole lane behind the target for 60%.

4.l1.name: Hallowed Steps
4.l1.text: After Radiance, Judgment's cooldown is reset.

4.l3.name: Second Sunrise
4.l3.text: If Radiance heals 3+ allies below 50% HP, its cooldown is 2 instead of 4 this time.
